description: semanticCommits: this repository writes Conventional Commits subjects itself, so Renovate follows the same convention.

packageRules.description: Workflows name actions by version tag and .github/workflows/actions.lock pins each to a commit. Renovate regenerates the lockfile with its action updates and would turn the digests config:best-practices pins back into version references.
CI runs every action, runner, and CI tool on the pull request itself, so their majors merge once checks pass. create-github-app-token runs only on a tag push, which no pull request exercises.

With warnings denied, a new Clippy, linter, or cargo-about release can fail CI. Keep these updates out of the routine group so a failure blocks only them; CI runs these tools on the pull request, so their majors and breaking updates also merge once checks pass.
rusqlite bundles SQLite, the storage engine of the state database every restore and task reads; a bad release needs its own revert, so its updates stay out of the routine group.

customManagers.description: The cargo manager leaves rust-version alone. Without this manager, a toolchain bump would leave the MSRV behind rust-toolchain.toml.
